# `tlgr conference`

9 operations. Every one takes the global flags (`--json`, `--plain`, `-a/--account`, `--results-only`, `--select`, `--dry-run`, `--yes`, `--no-input`, `--flood-wait-max`, `-v`) anywhere on the line.

| Command | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`conference chain list`](#tlgr-conference-chain-list) | Read the conference's E2E blockchain |
| [`conference create`](#tlgr-conference-create) | Create a call link (a conference call not tied to any chat) |
| [`conference decline`](#tlgr-conference-decline) | Decline a conference invitation, or stop ringing somebody you invited |

| [`conference invite`](#tlgr-conference-invite) | Ring somebody into a conference, falling back to sending them the link |
| [`conference join`](#tlgr-conference-join) | Join a conference call (requires E2E material tlgr cannot generate) |
| [`conference remove`](#tlgr-conference-remove) | Remove conference participants, or prune the ones that already left |
| [`conference revoke`](#tlgr-conference-revoke) | Revoke a conference's call link |
| [`conference send`](#tlgr-conference-send) | Send an E2E-encrypted in-call message, or a key-verification broadcast |

### `conference chain list`

Read the conference's E2E blockchain.

Blocks are base64 and unvalidated: tlgr is a transport for an external E2E implementation, not a participant in the protocol.

```
tlgr conference chain list <CALL> [OPTIONS]
```

**paginated (`LOCAL` cursor) · returns `Page[ChainBlock]`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CALL` | text | yes | A call link, slug or id:access_hash. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--offset` | int |  | Start at this height; -1 is the tip. |
| `--subchain` | int |  | 0 = group state, 1 = broadcasts. |
| `--tip` | flag |  | Only the latest block. |

Pagination is transport-level: `--limit/-n`, `--cursor TOKEN`, `--all` (walked inside the daemon, paced by the account's own rate limiter).

Also invocable as: `tlgr conf chain list`

```console
$ tlgr conference chain list AbCdEf --tip --json
```

### `conference create`

Create a call link (a conference call not tied to any chat).

```
tlgr conference create [OPTIONS]
```

**mutating · returns `ConferenceCreated`**

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--block` | path |  | Initial e2e.chain block for subchain 0. |
| `--join` | flag |  | Also join it — needs the E2E material. |
| `--muted/--unmuted` | flag | `True` | Join muted. |
| `--params-json` | path |  | tgcalls join payload. |
| `--public-key` | text |  | Your int256 E2E public key. |

Also invocable as: `tlgr conf create`

```console

```

### `conference decline`

```

```



### `conference remove`

Remove conference participants, or prune the ones that already left.

Needs the `remove_users` chain permission and a key-rotating block.

```
tlgr conference remove <CALL> [USER]... [OPTIONS]
```

**mutating · destructive (needs `--yes` off a TTY) · returns `ConferenceRemoved`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CALL` | text | yes | A call link, slug or id:access_hash. |
| `USER` | user | any number | Who to remove. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--block` | path |  | Removal block that rotates the key. |
| `--left-only` | flag |  | Prune participants that already dropped off. |

Also invocable as: `tlgr conf remove`, `tlgr conference kick`

```console
$ tlgr conference remove AbCdEf --left-only --block /tmp/b.bin --json
```

Partial: `conference.kick-participant`, `conference.prune-left`

the request is built and sent; the removal block that rotates the shared key is an e2e.chain builder tlgr does not have and accepts from outside

### `conference revoke`

Revoke a conference's call link.

Creator only. Nobody new can join with the old link.

```
tlgr conference revoke <CALL> [OPTIONS]
```

**mutating · destructive (needs `--yes` off a TTY) · returns `ConferenceRevoked`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |

| `CALL` | text | yes | A call link, slug or id:access_hash. |

